title: Gap observables in high-throughput OPV screening: code, data and analysis record
description: Code, intermediate data and analysis record for the manuscript 'Class-Dependent Errors of Cheap Band-Gap Observables Undermine High-Throughput Screening of Organic Photovoltaic Absorbers'. Compares stored PubChemQC Kohn-Sham gaps with sTDA-xTB excitation energies for 15,952 molecules, calibrates both against HOPV15 experimental optical gaps and four acenes, detects defective database records, and runs a validity-first calibrated Scharber cascade. Includes Lean 4 proofs of three statements about the screen.
